errors.evidence: The description states that the x-axis has uniform one-year intervals, but the labels on the chart are 2010, 2012, 2014, 2016, 2018, 2020, 2021, 2025, and 2030, which are not uniform intervals.
The line starts at approximately 1200 USD/kWh in 2010, not 1250 USD/kWh.
In 2014, the value is approximately 600 USD/kWh, not 750. The value is closer to 750 USD/kWh in the year 2012.
In 2018, the value is below 200 USD/kWh (approximately 180), not 300. The value is closer to 300 USD/kWh in the year 2016.
In 2025, the value is approximately 100 USD/kWh, not 200 USD/kWh.
